tip.zh:
🏠 今日北京晴到多云，气温约 4~16°C，清晨偏凉、体感约 2°C；无雨、风力不大，但空气质量偏差（PM2.5 偏高/霾），敏感人群减少户外久留、出门可戴口罩。
🏃 训练提醒：今天周一早上健身——无雨、风力不大，可按常规划健身房；主要冲突是空气质量偏差，若对雾霾敏感请缩短户外通勤暴露并优先室内训练。周二冬中午跑步：约 5~16°C、无雨、风力不大，跑步条件尚可，仍留意空气。周四可选跑：预报阴、阵风很强（模型阵风约 42 km/h），户外跑请改室内或改日。周五早上健身：约 4~11°C、阵风偏强（约 29 km/h），去健身房途中注意防风保暖；若周五再选户外跑同样建议避开强风。
📅 未来7天（北京，Open-Meteo；阴晴参考气象台/天气网，空气 Open-Meteo AQ）：
• 11/2 周一 4~16°C 晴到多云，无雨；晨练 OK，空气偏差
• 11/3 周二 5~16°C 多云（冬中午跑步日，无雨）
• 11/4 周三 5~11°C 有雾，略凉
• 11/5 周四 5~17°C 阴，阵风很强（可选跑慎户外）
• 11/6 周五 4~11°C 阴转凉，阵风偏强（晨练防风保暖）
• 11/7 周六 1~7°C 阴，明显偏冷
• 11/8 周日 2~11°C 阴，低温近冰点
• 11/9 周一 1~13°C 晴，风力略起
（气温/降水/风：Open-Meteo 约 08:15 北京时间；阴晴：天气网/实况偏晴霾；空气：Open-Meteo Air Quality）
tip.en:
🏠 Beijing today: mainly clear/partly cloudy, ~4–16°C, chilly mornings (feels ~2°C); dry with light wind, but poor air (elevated PM2.5/haze)—limit long outdoor exposure if sensitive.
🏃 Training: Mon morning gym — no rain, light wind, gym OK; main conflict is poor air quality—shorten outdoor commute exposure / prefer indoor if haze-sensitive. Tue winter noon run: ~5–16°C, dry, light wind — OK, still watch air. Thu optional run: overcast + strong gusts (~42 km/h) — prefer indoor or another day. Fri morning gym: cooler (~4–11°C) with stronger gusts (~29 km/h) — dress windproof; skip outdoor run if windy.
📅 Next 7 days (Beijing, Open-Meteo; sky cross-checked with weather.com.cn):
• Mon 11/2 4–16°C mainly clear (gym OK, dry; poorer air)
• Tue 11/3 5–16°C partly cloudy (noon run OK, dry)
• Wed 11/4 5–11°C fog, cooler
• Thu 11/5 5–17°C overcast, very strong gusts (caution for optional run)
• Fri 11/6 4–11°C overcast, cooler + gusty
• Sat 11/7 1–7°C overcast, notably cold
• Sun 11/8 2–11°C overcast, near-freezing lows
• Mon 11/9 1–13°C clear, a bit windier
(Temps/precip/wind: Open-Meteo ~08:15 Asia/Shanghai; sky: weather.com.cn; air: Open-Meteo AQ)

openingSummary.zh: 过去约两日，智能体与 Claude 应用、Codex/ChatGPT 用量节奏同台：Karpathy 用 Claude Opus 5.5 / Claude Code 在约两小时做出 HackerTube（从 20 年 HN 评论筛出高频推荐视频）；Anthropic 继续用数千 Claude agents 自动化「隐蔽涌现错位」红队；@thsottiaux 推进 Day 28「Banked」用量节奏。DeepMind PlanAssist（Gemini）仍是周末政务落地样本。缺口：OpenAI / @claudeai / Andrew Ng / Meta AI 自约 10/31 午后无新高信号原帖；关注列表内无 DeepSeek 一手动态；codex 预发布线已到 rust-v0.167.0-alpha.3（11/1），稳定版仍停在 0.166.0。
openingSummary.en: Over ~48 hours, agents + Claude in the wild and Codex/ChatGPT usage cadence led: Karpathy shipped HackerTube in ~2 hours with Claude Opus 5.5 / Claude Code (filtering 20 years of HN comments into repeatedly recommended videos); Anthropic’s thousands-of-Claude-agents subtle emergent-misalignment red-teaming stayed central; @thsottiaux pushed Day 28 “Banked” usage beats. DeepMind’s Gemini PlanAssist remained the weekend gov deployment sample. Gaps: OpenAI / @claudeai / Andrew Ng / Meta AI quiet after ~Oct 31 midday; no DeepSeek primary posts in this watchlist; Codex prerelease reached rust-v0.167.0-alpha.3 (Nov 1) while stable stays 0.166.0.

summary.zh: Karpathy 周末用 Claude Opus 5.5 / Claude Code 约两小时做出 HackerTube：从 20 年 HN 约 4300 万条评论筛出 6454 个反复被推荐的视频，显著好于 YouTube 推荐。
summary.en: Karpathy’s weekend hack: ~2 hours with Claude Opus 5.5 / Claude Code built HackerTube—filtering ~43M HN comments over 20 years down to 6,454 repeatedly recommended videos, beating YouTube recs.

summary.zh: Anthropic 发布对齐研究：用数千 Claude agents 自动生成看似无害却能诱使错位行为的训练数据，以改进训练数据监控与红队。
summary.en: Anthropic published alignment research: thousands of Claude agents automated subtle emergent-misalignment red-teaming by crafting training data that looks benign to monitors but teaches misaligned behavior.

summary.zh: ChatGPT/Codex 产品侧 Day 28：连续「Banked 2/2」，延续用量重置/积存节奏（接 Day 26 多账号切换与「banked」提示）。
summary.en: Codex/ChatGPT Day 28: “Banked 2/2”, continuing the usage-reset/bank cadence after Day 26’s multi-account switch + banked hint.

summary.zh: Day 27 窗口「Banked 1/2」：用量积存节奏推进，与随后 Day 28 的 2/2 形成连续信号。
summary.en: “Banked 1/2” in the Day-27 window—usage banking progressed, followed by Day 28’s 2/2.

summary.zh: DeepMind 与英方合作的 PlanAssist（基于 Gemini）可把家庭改建类规划审批评估时间最多缩短约 58%，并扩展到更多市政当局。
summary.en: DeepMind’s Gemini-built PlanAssist helped UK planning officers cut householder-application assessment time by up to 58%, now expanding to more councils.

summary.zh: Day 26：移动端已支持多账号切换，桌面端即将跟进；并提示随后两日与用量重置/「banked」相关。
summary.en: Day 26: multi-account switching live on mobile (desktop soon), with a hint about the next two days’ usage resets / banking.

title.zh: 自动化隐蔽涌现错位研究

summary.zh: 10/31：用数千 Claude agents 生成「监控器看起来无害、实则教错位」的训练数据，以规模化红队并改进训练数据监控。
summary.en: Oct 31: thousands of Claude agents craft monitor-benign yet misalignment-teaching data—scaling red-teaming and improving training-data monitors.

title.zh: Thin Orchestrator：让路由层更薄，智能体更稳
title.en: The Thin Orchestrator: more reliable AI agents by giving the router less to do

summary.zh: 10/19：数据流水线智能体把编排层刻意做薄（路由+可靠性检查），领域推理交给 14 个专精智能体，覆盖 20+ 工作流。
summary.en: Oct 19: keep the orchestrator thin (route + reliability checks) while 14 specialized agents do domain reasoning across 20+ workflows.

title.zh: JiTTesting：人在回路的全规模「落地前抓虫」
title.en: Catching Bugs Before They Land: JiTTesting’s Human-on-the-Loop Approach

summary.zh: 10/29：用 LLM 对 diff 生成即时测试（JiTTests），弱命中经规则+多模型 Judge 过滤后再人工复核。
summary.en: Oct 29: LLM just-in-time tests on diffs; rule + multi-model Judge filters weak catches before light human review.

alphaxivTop3.title: Proving and Improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs
alphaxivTop3.authors: Randall Balestriero, Yann LeCun (Brown / NYU / AMI)

summary.zh: alphaXiv Hot #1：多描述同场景训练可让独立学到的表征对齐，相对 next-token 预测更省数据（JEPA 路径）。
summary.en: alphaXiv Hot #1: training on multiple descriptions of the same scene can align independently learned representations—more data-efficient than next-token prediction (JEPA).

alphaxivTop3.title: Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm
alphaxivTop3.authors: Yuda Song, Alvin Zhang, Ruslan Salakhutdinov et al. (CMU / JHU)

summary.zh: alphaXiv Hot #2：在同一似然目标下混合静态数据与奖励筛选的模型生成，可提升推理并更好保留既有能力。
summary.en: alphaXiv Hot #2: mixing static data with reward-selected model generations under one likelihood objective can improve reasoning while better preserving earlier capabilities.

alphaxivTop3.title: Evolving Agent Teams
alphaxivTop3.authors: Shiyi Cao, Ziming Mao, Dacheng Li, Joseph E. Gonzalez, Ion Stoica (UC Berkeley)

summary.zh: （Agent 优先收录）编码智能体团队由督导按瓶颈动态重组+持久共享记忆，扩展预算下可写出快于生产 FlashInfer 的 GPU kernel。
summary.en: (Agent pick) Supervisor-driven evolving coding-agent teams + persistent memory escape local optima; extended budget yields CUDA kernels beating production FlashInfer on many workloads.
